note: AI-associated user agent tokens we check in each robots.txt. 'purpose': training = collects data for model training; search = builds an AI search index; fetch = retrieves a page live at a user's request.
headline: GPTBot

GPTBot.desc: Collects public web data that may be used to train OpenAI models.

ChatGPT-User.desc: Fetches a page live when a ChatGPT user asks about it.

OAI-SearchBot.desc: Builds the index behind ChatGPT search; blocking it removes you from ChatGPT search results.

ClaudeBot.desc: Collects public web data that may be used to train Anthropic models.

Claude-User.desc: Fetches a page live when a Claude user asks about it.

Claude-SearchBot.desc: Indexes pages to improve Claude's search citations.

Google-Extended.desc: Control token: blocking it opts your content out of Gemini training and grounding, without affecting Google Search.

Applebot-Extended.desc: Control token: blocking it opts your content out of Apple Intelligence training.

PerplexityBot.desc: Indexes pages for Perplexity's answer engine.

Perplexity-User.desc: Fetches a page live when a Perplexity user asks about it.

CCBot.desc: Builds the open Common Crawl corpus, historically a major source of AI training data.

Bytespider.desc: ByteDance's crawler, widely reported to gather AI training data; has a reputation for ignoring robots.txt.

meta-externalagent.desc: Collects public web data that may be used to train Meta's AI models.

Amazonbot.desc: Amazon's crawler; feeds Alexa answers and AI features.

MistralAI-User.desc: Fetches a page live when a Le Chat user asks about it.

anthropic-ai.desc: Legacy Anthropic control token; many sites still block it alongside ClaudeBot.

Claude-Web.desc: Legacy Anthropic browsing token, widely present in blocklists.

cohere-ai.desc: Cohere-associated token widely named in blocklists.

Diffbot.desc: Structured-data extraction service; its corpus feeds AI applications.

omgili.desc: Webz.io data crawler; sells web data used for AI training.

YouBot.desc: Crawler for You.com's AI search engine.

ImagesiftBot.desc: Image crawler associated with Hive's visual-AI products.

Timpibot.desc: Crawler for Timpi's decentralized search index.

Meta-ExternalFetcher.desc: Fetches pages live for Meta AI user requests.

AI2Bot.desc: Crawls for AI2's open language-model research (e.g. the Dolma corpus).

DeepSeekBot.desc: Crawler token associated with DeepSeek's models, appearing in blocklists.

GrokBot.desc: xAI/Grok crawler token, appearing in blocklists ahead of broad documentation.

PanguBot.desc: Crawler associated with Huawei's PanGu models.

Gemini-Deep-Research.desc: Token sites use to address Gemini's Deep Research agent.
